# Stories: Matthew McKeller 

Countless years of my life have been dedicated to understanding this world, learning how to breathe new life into the world, and creating solutions for the best possible future, and becoming the best possible me.

Way TMI, but I got a ridiculous amount of life experience in addition to all of this technical knowledge. To me, its incredible. But strange. Help me do this properly please. 

\<YcDetailsForProfileData\>

Transformative Learning For Mental Health Improvements  
**\<Image TransformationFlow\>**  
Depression \-\> Happiness  \- / \+ 	Now Able to Handle Multiple Perspectives  
Sadness || Anger			Expression \= Function(Information, Situation, Person, etc)  
Anxiety \-\> Understood 		Managed, Utilized, Learned  
Perspective				Evolved.  
**\</Image Transformation Flow\>**

**\<Image ScaleBeforeAndAfter\>**  
Scale Relative Comparison: Am happier with no items, no partner, minimal items, but environmental context is difficult, still, I am generally happy with Nothing. And Also, I recognize that I’m put in these situations for reasons. Every Time.   
**\</Image ScaleBeforeAndAfter\>**  
**\<ImageList ExperienceHighlights/\>**  
**\<ImageList LearningHighlights/\>**

**\<RLGamification: Live Human Interactivity & Engagement\>**  
Casting Spells, Reacting, Interacting, Playing games, Using observability at whatever level you want when or when you do not want it.  
Interacting with the world differently than you could before.  
\<Include Page?\>  
**\</RL\_Gamification\>**

**\<RL\_Learning\>**

**\<Starcraft\_IRL\>**  
Planning, Playing Starcraft Mining minerals and bringing them to factories that I built with robots and have on pipelines building houses.  
Probably lots of wood utilization.  
**\</StarcraftIRL\>**

Adding more interactivity and learning integrations into your life so that you can better understand yourself and achieve your goals. Don't know what goals you want? Explore options.

**\<EntertainmentData\>**  
For me, Solo leveling is important \#Content, Gaming is important, Creativity, Intellect, AI (\#LifeExperiencedAs(\[Game, Media, Matrix, Chat, NextLevelEducation, NextLevelCommunication\]) That means that when this information is used I'm going to be more interested in it, and retain more information about those topics. Can I use that please? \#Integrations \#Why   
**\<EntertainmentData\>**

**\<ValueData/\>**  
**\<FlawsData/\>**  
**\<StrengthsData/\>**  
**\<SituationalContext/\>**

**\<Emotion.Anger\>**  
Inspect dossiers live on the profile action **Inspect Emotion** (events, perspectives, ideas, comments) and the write-up:

→ [Emotion.Inspect · Anger · HealthCare, Food, Tools, Choice](/docs/web4/emotion-inspect-anger-healthcare-food-tools-choice)  
→ Education · KC Education section: [same page § Education.Status](/docs/web4/emotion-inspect-anger-healthcare-food-tools-choice#education-status-kc-education)

Also being able to have a character profile, that 0 of these platforms seem to allow, including X.com

Why is this? Why are people not taught how to better control their characters? Why was I? This is an important question to me. A question that makes me want to rewrite, wants me to review in stages, make sure someone else reviews it

Then, turns out, I can actually control every character. But, because of this I realized I there is very little I know about these people. One of the things I've learned though is that the name is incredibly Powerful. Do you want a redo? Or is it perfect for you? Why do we have so much disconnect in our platforms and internet? who are popular and powerful. I hear about products and stuff, but once I finally learned what was the most important to being a human I really started to question my reality even more. Why do they hide? Is it because they are scared to reveal this information? But Can't we have it?
